description:
Sitting on the school yard, gazing at the sky, outside the window during class, waiting for a friend at the bus stop—love came unexpectedly. A sweet love story of two boys who are having a fling.

1. Jin-Woo and Young-Won: Jin-Woo, a good cook, a conceited, affectionate prisoner, and tactless, has grown listless in his dull daily life. Then, he falls in love at first sight with Young-Won, a senior he meets on school yard. However, Young-Won, everyone's idol, is already famous for his sharp rejection of confessions. It's only natural that if he, a stranger, confesses, he'll be 100% rejected! Jin-Woo decides to use his specialty, cooking, to tame Young-Won's stomach. Jin-Woo's "From Everyone's Senior to My Young-Won Project" ends in a mess. 

2. Tae-Heon and Ah-Seong: A conscious, introverted, tactless, and a gold digger. Tae-Heon's childhood friend Ah-Seong has a penchant for falling in love easily, regardless of gender. Falling in love faster than anyone else, feeling heartbroken faster than anyone else. Tae-Heon, who knew every detail of Ah-Seong's love life, suddenly had a question.

 *"Hey, but why do you fall for everyone but not me?"*

Tae-Heon confidently offered to make Ah-Seong fall for him, despite Ah-Seong's disapproval. Ah-Seong couldn't understand why he was acting like that...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
